title: Delve: Site Name – Format
description: Roll on the Template table, then fill each blank from the matching Site Name oracle.
postamble:
To generate a name for a delve site, first roll on the Template table. Then, fill in the blanks using the tables in this section.

If the form of a particular word doesn't work, try making it plural instead of singular (or vice-versa).

Then, envision the nature and history of the site using its name as inspiration.
